name.note: Name of the RO; provisional while it is a Draft, a row without an identifier. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

description.note: What the RO is. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

identifier.note: Persistent link to the RO as an https URL: https://doi.org/… where it has a DOI (for Zenodo the DOI for all versions), otherwise its landing page. Empty while the RO is a Draft (still being made or not yet deposited); never a storage path. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

private_link.note: Where non-public files are kept, such as a project-drive path. Never an access key or other secret: anyone with the link can read this sheet.

case_study.note: Case studies the RO serves; Other if none of the three. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

regulatory_question.note: Regulatory questions of the case studies the RO addresses (platform.vhp4safety.nl/casestudies/<case>/Q1 or Q2); N/A if none. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

work_package.note: VHP4Safety work package that produced the RO.

workflow_step.note: Process flow steps of the VHP4Safety glossary (glossary.vhp4safety.nl). On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

creative_work_status.note: Where the files of the RO are. Not shared: the tracker owner does not have them. Partially shared: the owner has some of them. Shared: not public, and the files are in the deposit folder on the owner's laptop. Private: in a public repository but not yet released. Public: openly available. Private and Public need an identifier. On BioStudies rows the daily script sets Public once a file is attached, the record is released and embargo_date has passed, and turns an earlier Public into Shared.

embargo_date.note: Date from which the data may be public, as YYYY-MM-DD; empty if there is no embargo. No file is attached before it.

date_published.note: Date the RO's metadata are (or will be) public, as YYYY-MM-DD: for Zenodo the publication date of its first version, for an article the date its DOI was registered. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

license.note: SPDX licence identifier (spdx.org/licenses) of the RO, from the deposit at the identifier. On BioStudies rows the daily script copies it from the record; edits there are overwritten.

has_metadata.note: FAIRplus Data Maturity indicator the metadata meet (fairplus.github.io/Data-Maturity/docs/Indicators); N/A if no dataset descriptor can be assessed.

has_toxtemp.note: Whether a ToxTemp (template to report toxicity test methods) exists for the RO; N/A if the RO is not a test method or its data.

has_ro_crate.note: Yes if an RO-Crate is published with the RO. On BioStudies rows the daily script sets it from the files attached to the record; edits there are overwritten.

contact_person.note: People to contact about the RO, each written Given Family, separated by ', '.

partner_code.note: Partner institution of the contact person.

type.note: schema.org or Bioschemas type of the RO, matching the Zenodo resource type: Dataset (dataset), ScholarlyArticle (journal article), SoftwareSourceCode (software), CreativeWork (model or poster; schema.org has no model type), ComputationalWorkflow (workflow), PresentationDigitalDocument (presentation), MediaObject (video), LearningResource (lesson). A Zenodo RO takes the type of its record.

is_reviewed.note: Whether the RO and its RO-Crate metadata were reviewed within the project.

fa_status.note: Whether the RO can be found, discovered and/or accessed via platform.vhp4safety.nl.

notes.note: Anything no other column holds, in English; a related RO by its identifier.
